meta.name: orchestrate
meta.description: Multi-agent coordination across plan/implement/test/review; fan-out for 3+ independent workstreams. Triggers "coordinate", "orchestrate", "complex task", "parallel agents", "split work", "fan out", "multi-instance", large refactor, "overnight", "long running", "autonomous task", "extended task", "marathon", "multi-hour task".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 协调多个智能体并行执行复杂任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理多个自主代理或编排并行工作流
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multiple agents to execute complex tasks in parallel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage multiple autonomous agents or orchestrate parallel workflows

howto.what: 装上后，Claude遇到复杂任务会将其拆解为多个独立工作流，并行委派给子智能体处理，并独立验证每个子智能体的结果。对于超大型任务，它采用分阶段执行，自动保存检查点以便中断后恢复。
howto.when: 当用户说出“orchestrate”、“complex task”、“parallel agents”等关键词，或要求执行大型重构、长时间运行任务时触发。

say.text: 编排一个并行任务：重构前端并添加测试。
say.note: Claude会分解任务并派发子智能体。

say.text: 用分阶段执行方式迁移所有类组件到hooks。
say.note: Claude会规划阶段并设置检查点。

say.text: 启动长时间运行任务：分析整个代码库。
say.note: Claude进入多智能体编排模式。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude breaks complex tasks into independent workstreams, delegates them to multiple sub-agents in parallel, and independently verifies each sub-agent's results. For very large tasks, it uses phased execution with checkpoints for interruption recovery.
howto.when_en: Triggered by keywords like "orchestrate", "complex task", "parallel agents", or requests for large refactor, long-running, or autonomous tasks.

say_en.text: Orchestrate a parallel task: refactor frontend and add tests.
Use phased execution to migrate all class components to hooks.
say_en.note: Claude plans phases and sets checkpoints.

say_en.text: Start a long-running task: analyze the entire codebase.
